svg.title: FB_Safe2Ch - test E1: e-stop mirror, power-on reset, press, reset, discrepancy and cross-fault reset
svg.text: FB_Safe2Ch - test E1: e-stop mirror, power-on reset, press, reset, discrepancy and cross-fault reset
Diagnostic MIRROR of a 2-channel safety input - the safety function (stop, release) is done by the certified block in the F-program, not by this FB.
tick k (x 100 ms) - events change inputs before the call of that tick
tick 1: both closed but latched from power-on -> reset request lamp ; tick 3 reset -> OK ; tick 8 pressed ; tick 12 reset ; tick 20 only channel 2 opens ;
tick 24: 5 calls = 500 ms -> discrepancy ; tick 30 reset refused (channels never both open) ; tick 33 both open (cross test) ; tick 37 reset -> OK.
